title: Patch: the Duos fuzz forges prompt answers, sends emotes and tries wrapper-refused bodies

**Issue #1695 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1695: Patch: the Duos fuzz forges prompt answers, sends emotes and tries wrapper-refused bodies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The co-op fuzz has only two forgery probes while the 1v1 fuzz has the full set: it never sends a malformed prompt answer inside a duel, never sends an emote even when the duel offers it, and never tries the bodies the co-op wrapper itself refuses — a draw offer sent as a duel action, a duel-level concede, a timeout. After this the co-op gate gets the same three probes, reusing the 1v1 machinery.

## Why

- `probe_duos_state` (`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`) has only reused-nonce and wrong-seat probes.
- `malformed_answers` is `pub` in the engine's testkit and operates on a `GameState` — each duel is one — so it ports directly, wrapped in `DuosActionBody::Duel` for the prompt holder's seat.
- `Duel{Emote}` is filtered out by `AI_SKIPPED_ACTIONS` yet is legal whenever `emotes_heard` and passes `why_duel_refused`'s fallthrough arm — zero coverage, including its propagation into the four redacted views.
- `why_duel_refused` (`crates/engine/src/duos/legal.rs`) rejects Concede-as-Duel, OfferDraw/AnswerDraw, SetAutoEndTurn, Timeout and DisconnectExpired — never forged; `judge_duos_refusal` already exists.

## Proposal

(a) Apply `malformed_answers` to the duel holding the pending prompt, wrapped for its seat; (b) send `Duel{Emote}` from `duos_endings_action` while the duel lists it (the 1v1 endings channel's pattern); (c) add a rotating probe asserting each wrapper-refused body is refused with state kept.

## Where it lands

`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`; reuse in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`; the validator under test is `crates/engine/src/duos/legal.rs`. Spec §13.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Malformed answers inside duels are forged and refused with state unchanged.
- [ ] `Duel{Emote}` is sent when listed and its redaction holds in all four views.
- [ ] Each wrapper-refused body is probed refused with state kept.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --duos` and the duos fuzz tests green.

## Size and risks

Small, ~200 lines. Care picking the right duel and seat for a prompt, and sending emote only while listed. Low risk.
```
